product: Power plant equipment and EPC: nuclear (APR1400 and SMR components, forgings), gas and steam turbines, combined-cycle and thermal plants, castings and forgings, plus wind, hydrogen and ESS.
demand: AI data centres and new nuclear drive orders: seven US gas turbines for data centres (Mar 2026), a first North American steam-turbine order (Mar 2026), and a record backlog above KRW26tn in H1 2026 (aggregators). Middle East gas and China nuclear demand is steady.
pricing_power: Contracts are lumpy and negotiated project by project, and no company disclosure of price increases was found. Analysts credit order volume and mix rather than pricing, and a Q2 2026 net margin of 3.34 percent suggests limited pricing power.
competition: GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Mitsubishi Power in gas turbines; Westinghouse, Framatome and HD Hyundai in nuclear; Chinese and Korean EPC firms in combined cycle. A Korean report (24 Sep) called Doosan a gas-turbine dark horse that beat German incumbents in the US.
team: Chairman Park Jeong-won leads Doosan Group; Jongdoo Kim heads the Nuclear Business Group and Hyeonho Lee the Plant EPC Business Group (company IR releases). Management points to a first-ever order backlog above KRW26tn in H1 2026 as evidence of execution.
market_strategy: Sell equipment into the US AI data-centre power and nuclear build-out and Middle East combined-cycle EPC: strategic partner to Rolls-Royce SMR and X-energy, supplier to TerraPower, and targeting SMR commercialisation by 2035 with public calls for regulatory change.
bull: Record backlog above KRW26tn in H1 2026 with dated orders: Oman Misfah KRW930bn (IR, 21 Aug), TerraPower Natrium (IR, 14 Aug), China Laiyang forgings (IR, 27 Jul); mix shifting to gas turbines, SMR parts and nuclear forgings.
bear: Q2 2026 net margin 3.34 percent, levered FCF KRW-378bn, ~292x trailing earnings, debt-to-equity 58 percent; KB cut its target 10.3 percent on 23 Jul citing delayed US nuclear awards; foreign and institutional investors net sellers 18-23 Sep.
falsifier: Any company disclosure or filing before 31 Dec 2026 showing H2 2026 order intake below H1 2026, or a confirmed slip of the US nuclear awards past 2027.
web_what_changed: Aug-Sep 2026: Oman Misfah 1,700MW CCGT contract about KRW930bn (company IR, 21 Aug), TerraPower Natrium equipment order (IR, 14 Aug), China Laiyang 5-6 forgings (IR, 27 Jul). In September Korea's US investment package took shape: Texas gas plant first, eight US reactors discussed, Westinghouse stake pursued (aggregators 22-23 Sep).
web_not_known_yesterday: Almost nothing dated 25 Sep 2026: the KOSPI was shut for Chuseok on 24-25 Sep, so the last print is 23 Sep, close 82,700 KRW, down 4.4 percent. The company published no new release; 24 Sep items (US reactor talks, Nepal flood search) already circulated 22-23 Sep.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume and demand led, not price: record order backlog above KRW26tn in H1 2026 (aggregator, 27 Jul) from AI data-centre power and nuclear build-out. Q2 2026 revenue KRW4.72tn, net KRW157.6bn, margin 3.34 percent (Yahoo). Mix is shifting toward gas turbines, SMR parts and nuclear forgings.
web_suppliers: Not found in primary sources. Doosan is itself a forgings supplier using its 17,000-ton press (company IR, 27 Jul) and buys generator stators from Bumhan Mechatec under a long-term supply deal (aggregator, 23 Sep). No evidence found that its own inputs are constrained.
web_customers: Concentrated, mostly one project each: Nebras Power/EUDC/BIS consortium for Oman Misfah (IR, 21 Aug), TerraPower for Natrium (IR, 14 Aug), Dongfang Electric for China Laiyang 5-6 (IR, 27 Jul), plus KEPCO/Aramco Jafurah, Rolls-Royce SMR, X-energy and emerging US hyperscaler data-centre buyers (aggregators).
web_who_loses: Rival equipment vendors: GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Mitsubishi Power in gas turbines; Westinghouse, Framatome, Equipos Nucleares, HD Hyundai and Marmen in nuclear components (World Nuclear News, 21 Aug). Chinese and Korean EPC firms also lose Middle East combined-cycle tenders to Doosan.
web_contradicting_evidence: The stock has nearly halved from its KRW139,200 high and trades near 292x trailing earnings with levered free cash flow of KRW-378bn (Yahoo). Korean brokers cut targets 23-28 Jul citing delayed US nuclear orders, KB by 10.3 percent. Foreign and institutional investors were net sellers 18-23 Sep (Naver).
web_if_management_right: Backlog converts: Oman Misfah, Saudi Jafurah, US gas turbines and nuclear forgings ship through 2029, US reactor and SMR orders land after the November midterms, and mix shifts to higher-margin equipment. Consensus mean target was KRW130,333 on 23 Sep 2026 (Naver) against an 82,700 spot price.
web_if_management_wrong: Fixed-price EPC execution breaks first, squeezing margins and cash, then US nuclear awards slip past 2027 and the 292x multiple de-rates. Watch Nepal flood liabilities, debt-to-equity of 58 percent (Yahoo) and negative free cash flow.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Korean power-equipment supply chain: Bumhan Mechatec (generator stators, 23 Sep), HD Hyundai and KEPCO E&C on TerraPower and US projects, Hyundai Engineering & Construction, POSCO International, CNPlus for offshore-wind installation, and subsidiary Doosan Skoda Power, whose H1 EBITDA rose 40 percent (aggregator, 24 Sep).
